description: Availability calendar; booking engine; channel manager updates to the two OTAs; new bookings, changes, and cancellations; the guest register
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without the calendar the OTAs keep selling rooms, so a day without sync risks double bookings, relocation costs, and OTA ranking penalties; about $490 average and up to $930 peak revenue a day; RPO set by the innkeeping vendor's backups (RPO 1 hour stated in its SOC 2 system description)
manual_workaround: Close availability in each OTA portal from the phone; keep a printed 14-day arrivals list; take phone bookings on paper without card numbers and enter them after recovery
dependent_third_parties: Innkeeping software vendor; OTA-1; OTA-2; internet service provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-innkeeper (single point of failure for credentials); relief innkeeper as backup operator

business_process: Guest arrival, stay, and room access
description: Check-in and ID check; per-reservation door codes; guest Wi-Fi; breakfast; answering guests during the stay
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Guest safety and security: guests must be able to enter and lock their rooms day and night; door codes come from reservation data in SYS-01; a full house is 6 rooms of guests on site
manual_workaround: Mechanical override keys from the lockbox; owner or relief innkeeper lets guests in; printed arrivals list; guest Wi-Fi outage is an inconvenience only
dependent_third_parties: Smart lock vendor; innkeeping software vendor; internet service provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-innkeeper or relief innkeeper on site; the house; cleaning service for room turns

description: Booking engine deposits; charging OTA virtual cards; phone booking payments; card-present payments at check-in and for incidentals; refunds
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deposits are already captured for most stays; balances can be taken at departure or by invoice; about $3,200 of card payments a week on average; payment records are held by the payment facilitator
manual_workaround: Take balances at departure; send a pay-by-link from the facilitator's portal once enabled; accept checks from known repeat guests; never write card numbers on paper
dependent_third_parties: Payment facilitator; innkeeping software vendor; OTAs

description: Phone calls; email; guest messaging in the innkeeping software and OTA portals; website contact form and chat assistant
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Guests need arrival instructions, door codes, and answers before and during stays; OTAs measure response times; most messages can be resent
manual_workaround: Phone calls and texts from the mobile phone; post arrival instructions on the front door; turn off the chat assistant
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-06; SYS-08; SYS-11
dependent_third_parties: Email and file provider; OTAs; phone carrier; website builder

description: Payout reconciliation; Florida sales and tourist development tax returns; license and insurance records; vendor contracts; stored documents
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly tax and bookkeeping deadlines are measured in days; RPO of 24 hours is met for the accounting SaaS but not for laptop files, which have no backup
manual_workaround: Use the accounting SaaS and vendor portals directly; paper copies of the license, insurance, and key contracts in the office
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; bookkeeper; email and file provider
